summary: Frontend testing of /cosmetic-dentistry page for Zubite.bg. All 10 features tested and passed. Page follows standardized layout: Hero → How it Works → Problem/Solution Sections → Pricing → FAQ → Final CTA. Lead form submission to /api/leads works correctly with success message displayed.
